nodes.name: asset
nodes.summary: Digital asset management service: CRUD/listing/tagging/bulk APIs for assets, ingests resource-manager and rasterizer outputs into persistent asset records via EventBridge/SQS, and syncs assets and creative versions to the WSS-only PMH integration.

nodes.name: fetch(pmhApiBaseUrl + PMH path) -> PMH (Print Media Hub) external API
nodes.raw: fetch(pmhApiBaseUrl + PMH path) -> PMH (Print Media Hub) external API
nodes.reason: fetch() target is the external Print Media Hub (PMH) API base URL (PMH_API_BASE_URL env var, a WSS-only integration; see t.yml PMH), not a Unite service path, and not one of the declared 3rd-party SDKs either.

nodes.name: fetch(uploadUrl) -> caller-provided PMH/GCS signed upload URL
nodes.raw: fetch(uploadUrl) -> caller-provided PMH/GCS signed upload URL
nodes.reason: uploadUrl is a runtime value returned by createPmhUploadUrl (the PMH API's response), not a static Unite path or literal host; the destination host varies per call and cannot be resolved statically.
